metadata.description: Agent skills for iOS and Swift development

plugins.name: app-store-release
plugins.description: Automate App Store Connect release chores through Apple's official API instead of the website: check where a version, build upload or review stands, whether a version is ready to submit, and why a build failed, draft release notes from git history and push them as localized "What's New", pull and push store listing text, find missing localizations (listing, in-app purchases, Game Center), create versions and attach builds, upload screenshots, submit for App Review, release approved versions, and read or reply to customer reviews. Use whenever the user wants to ship, release or submit an iOS app version, asks where a version or build stands or why a build is missing, or wants to know what is missing before submitting, or wants release notes, listing text, localization gaps, screenshots or review replies handled, even if they never mention the API or this skill by name.

plugins.name: ios-aso
plugins.description: Audit and improve how an iOS app is found and how well its product page converts on the App Store - check the name, subtitle, keyword field and localizations against Apple's rules and character budgets, find keywords that are wasted or repeated across storefronts, pack a ranked keyword list into the 100-character field, and review screenshots, preview, ratings and product page tests. iOS only, built on Apple's own guidance and on the real App Store Connect fields. Use whenever the user asks about ASO, App Store optimization, keywords, ranking or visibility in App Store search, why an app is not found or not downloaded, improving the subtitle, name or screenshots, which languages to localize for, or comparing against competitors, even if they never say ASO.

plugins.name: all-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this repository, installed together.
